body: Zendesk for Employee Service

Give employees the support they deserve with an intuitive service solution that powers every phase of work. Zendesk AI helps automate requests, surface knowledge, and resolve issues faster so work keeps moving.
14-day free trial. No credit card required.
Discover how Employee Service AI Agents connect across knowledge sources, respect permissions, and resolve employee requests in the flow of work.
For IT teams
Help IT stay efficient Bring request and incident management, knowledge, and assets into one easy-to-use workspace, powered by AI, so teams can manage support more efficiently from day one.
Resolve issues faster Zendesk AI automates routine employee requests, guides teams with contextual suggestions, and monitors quality in real-time so teams deliver faster, more consistent support.
Keep costs low You don’t need a developer army to start using Zendesk for employee service. Launch quickly, scale easily, and reduce manual effort with built-in automation and AI.
For HR teams

Improve employee experience and satisfaction Deliver 24/7 support in the tools employees already use, like Slack and Teams, with self-service and AI that finds trusted answers, automates tasks, and speeds resolution.
Deliver consistent, compliant service Simplify onboarding, offboarding, approvals, and life-event management with automated workflows that save time and support compliance.

Keep HR productive Give HR teams an easier way to support employees with a solution that integrates with the systems they use every day, cuts down on repetitive work, and gives them more time to focus on what matters most: your people.
Why Zendesk for employee service
Ready from day 1 and built to scale to any complexity without an army of developers, meaning fast time to value and low TCO.
AI trained on 18+ billion service interactions to deliver the fast, accurate service your employees deserve.
Integrate, adapt and customize without the high cost or heavy resources to keep pace with a rapidly evolving workplace.
An intuitive solution that is loved by employees and unlocks greater productivity, whether you’re getting or giving support.
Zendesk delivers AI-first automation, fast deployment, and seamless workflows to help IT teams resolve issues faster and scale effortlessly.
Source: IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled IT Service Management Software 2026 Vendor Assessment (Doc #US54115226, September 2026)
What Zendesk AI can do for you
Surface relevant knowledge in context for both employees and service teams. Unify and connect knowledge to deliver self-service with instant, accurate answers that reduce ticket volume.
Take a guided tour of our employee service solution and see how AI-powered workflows can help your teams deliver faster, more seamless employee support.
